newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on retail selling.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on retail selling.

text.p: Dhaka stocks sank more than one percent at the close on Wednesday as selling pressure from mostly small investors strained prices across the board, brokers said.

The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) lost 19.06 points or 1.09 percent to 1,720.24. Turnover was 78.2 million taka. Of 113 traded issues, 85 gained, 24 lost and four were unchanged. "We expected the market to consolidate Tuesday's recovery. But investors are now too watchful and do not want to hold scrips for even days," said one broker.
Beximco Pharma led the volume with 55,000 shares traded at 4.49 taka lower at 232.20 and Monno Ceramics lost 20 to 1,204.
